main_body: draped altar block on a stepped stone dais
top_band: white altar cloth with light purple runner and gold cross, rows 11-23
evidence: Reading down the middle column: rows 11-23 form a lighter horizontal top surface (white cloth with a light lavender runner, 13 rows tall), row 24 is a bright gold front-edge trim line, row 25 is a darker gold/brown underside shadow, and rows 26-35 form the darker purple vertical front face (10 rows tall) above the stepped stone base (rows 36-46).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul stall and well references, the candidate has large unshaded flat fills: two 8x13 blocks of pure flat white on the top cloth, a flat lavender runner, and flat horizontal grey bands on the stone steps and pillar with no surface grain, speckle, or per-stone shading.
